note: vespera-bridge: an empty or blank-only vespera.bridge.exposed-apps value (for example an unset placeholder) now fails startup instead of leaving the app allowlist unrestricted; an absent property stays unrestricted. A known-length request body that the container ends early is answered 400 instead of being forwarded short. A streamed request whose header cannot be encoded keeps its InputStream sendable. The learned-app tag cap holds under concurrent first answers. Javadoc and README corrected for the virtual-thread heap path, the auto-configuration bean gating, the platform list and the response Content-Type drop. Test-quality fixes in the bridge and demo-app suites (native-free direct pool test, per-path event assertions, narrowed swallowed exceptions, gated micro-benchmark).
